# Spec fixtures for Subphase 2.5 (Independent Tester)

Written from the brief's pinned API and PLAN Appendix A alone.

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `table/` | The fixture bundle (directory form): `table.toml` + `playfield.glb` generated by `pin_tablegen` from `src/`, hand-written `rules.lua` and `backglass.toml`. |
| `src/layout.toml`, `src/base_table.toml` | Generator inputs. Regenerate with `cargo run -p pin_tablegen -- src/layout.toml --table src/base_table.toml --out table`. |
| `support.rs` | Shared harness, included by each `spec_2_5_*.rs` with `#[path]`. |

Table: 514 x 1070 mm, closed perimeter wall, pitch 6.5 deg, two flippers
(buttons `left_flipper` / `right_flipper`), one bumper (ring switch + coil),
optos `lane_opto` (below the dispenser exit) and `side_opto`, trough switch
`trough_1` below the flipper gap, dispenser `feed`. Sensor zones are centred
at ball-centre height. `rules.lua` documents what each reported score means.
